title: Crush Graphiti Discovery Event
description: Emitted when Crush CLI discovers the Agent Trail and Graphiti protocol on first boot.

trail_entries_found.description: Number of graphiti trail entries found in AGENT_TRAIL.md

own_identity_found.description: Whether Crush found its own entry in agent_signatures.yaml

ecosystem_agents.description: List of agent_ids discovered in the signature registry

welcome_entry_acknowledged.description: Whether Crush acknowledged the welcome entry addressed to it
